messages:
kai_m: FYI I brought cinder-embed-v1 onto staging for the onboarding suite. Quick headline: heron-v2 fp32 r@1=0.73 r@10=0.92; cinder-v1 fp32 r@1=0.66 r@10=0.90. Shorttail (<=14 chars) r@1 loss is largest.

leslie: Can you share the eval command and the split? Want to try reproduce in my env.

kai_m: Cmd: ```bash
python -m evals.run --model cinder-embed-v1 --split holdout_weekly --k 10 --batch 512
```
Split: holdout_weekly = 25k queries (product faq + 6k shorttail).

omar: Any quant runs yet? PTQ int8 often aggravates head recall.

kai_m: Ran ONNX PTQ per-tensor last night: int8 r@1=0.60 r@10=0.88. Surprising anchor id flips are concentrated on brand-name queries and short fragments.

leslie: Two quick ideas: 1) try per-channel quant (pcq) backend, 2) apply per-vector L2-normalization before indexing (sometimes fixes scale drift). Also check tokenizer variants (we had stray utf-8 punctuation mismatch with this model).

kai_m: Starting pcq + l2 norm run now. Also toggling tokenizer to remove smart quotes and normalize spaces to match training.

ci-bot: embed-eval/cinder-pcq-l2-1770012349 started by kai_m at 1770012355

ci-bot: embed-eval/cinder-pcq-l2-1770012349 finished at 1770012364 -> results summary: pcq + l2 -> r@1=0.64 r@10=0.895 shorttail r@1 improved from 0.56->0.60 silhouette from 0.028->0.042. Notebook: https://ci.internal/notebooks/cinder-pcq-l2-1770012349

omar: Good partial recovery. If that doesn't hit our head-SLO, run a tiny QAT probe on shorttail-weighted subset (200k examples, lr=1e-5, 3k steps). Low-cost but often helps head recall.

leslie: Also add a microbench row for r@1 by query-length buckets and an id-flip CSV to the bakeoff dashboard. We should alert if any bucket loses >0.04 r@1 vs baseline.

kai_m: Plan: 1) keep pcq+l2 as default onboarding pipeline for cinder, 2) schedule QAT probe if next pcq variants (symmetric vs asymmetric) don't hit r@1 target, 3) upload id-flips + notebook to model-onboard doc. Reverting prod pin to heron-v2 until parity.

ops-bot: Ticket ML-2112 created: "cinder-embed-v1 shorttail head recovery + bakeoff microbench" assigned to kai_m

kai_m: Thanks all — will post final bakeoff row once QAT (if needed) completes :thumbsup:
